summary: Tested signature placement drag & drop overlay feature. All 10 frontend features verified working: placement overlay appears after signing, draggable signature shows typed text or drawn image, position info bar displays X/Y coordinates, zoom controls work, cancel closes overlay, confirm saves with position, document shown as background, signature moves when dragged.
passed_tests: FRONTEND: After signing in SignaturePad, placement overlay (signature-placement-overlay) appears
FRONTEND: Draggable signature element (draggable-signature) shows typed text
FRONTEND: Draggable signature element (draggable-signature) shows drawn image
FRONTEND: Position info bar shows current X/Y coordinates (placement-position-info) - Default: X=200, Y=400
FRONTEND: Position info bar updates after drag - e.g., X=619, Y=465
FRONTEND: Cancel button (placement-cancel) closes overlay without saving
FRONTEND: Confirm button (placement-confirm) saves signature with position
FRONTEND: Success toast shows 'Unterschrift platziert und gespeichert' after confirm
FRONTEND: Document is shown as background (PDF iframe - placement-doc-pdf)
FRONTEND: Signature moves when dragged with mouse
FRONTEND: 2-step sign flow works: Sign dialog -> Placement overlay -> Save with position

context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested NEW visual drag-and-drop signature placement overlay. The SignaturePlacement component (SignaturePlacement.js) is a fixed fullscreen overlay (z-[70]) that shows after signing in SignaturePad. Key data-testids: signature-placement-overlay, draggable-signature, placement-position-info, placement-zoom-in, placement-zoom-out, placement-cancel, placement-confirm, placement-doc-pdf, placement-doc-image. Default signature position is X=200, Y=400. The 2-step flow is: handleSign in DocumentPanel -> setPlacingSignature -> handlePlacementConfirm which calls POST /api/meetings/{meeting_id}/documents/{doc_id}/sign with pos_x, pos_y, page fields.
